mapper.select: SELECT retention_days FROM ai_chat_retention WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_retention(tenant_id,user_id,retention_days) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{userId},#{days}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE retention_days=VALUES(retention_days)
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_chat_conversation SET retain_until=#{date},modify_by=#{modifyBy} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM ai_chat_conversation WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_task_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED')
SELECT stream_key FROM ai_task_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND stream_key IS NOT NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_run_sources WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId}
DELETE FROM ai_chat_message WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_chat_conversation SET status='DELETED',default_slot=NULL,title='已删除',retain_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE ai_task_step s JOIN ai_task_run r ON r.run_id=s.task_run_id SET s.input_json=NULL,s.output_json=NULL,s.error_message=NULL WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.conversation_id=#{conversationId}

UPDATE ai_request_log l JOIN ai_task_run r ON r.request_id=l.request_id AND r.tenant_id=l.tenant_id SET l.question=NULL,l.error_message=NULL WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.conversation_id=#{conversationId}

UPDATE ai_tool_execute_log l JOIN ai_task_run r ON r.request_id=l.request_id AND r.tenant_id=l.tenant_id SET l.question=NULL,l.error_message=NULL WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.conversation_id=#{conversationId}
UPDATE ai_task_run SET question='',plan_json=NULL,error_message=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.tenant_id,c.user_id FROM ai_chat_conversation c LEFT JOIN ai_chat_retention p ON p.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND p.user_id=c.user_id WHERE c.status='ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(c.retain_until,DATE_ADD(COALESCE(c.last_message_at,c.create_time),INTERVAL COALESCE(p.retention_days,90) DAY))<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_task_run r WHERE r.conversation_id=c.id AND r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED')) LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_conversation c LEFT JOIN ai_chat_retention p ON p.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND p.user_id=c.user_id WHERE c.id=#{id} AND c.status='ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(c.retain_until,DATE_ADD(COALESCE(c.last_message_at,c.create_time),INTERVAL COALESCE(p.retention_days,90) DAY))<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_task_run r WHERE r.conversation_id=c.id AND r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED'))
